name: Baradroid
source:
Evan is an AI graduate student who dreams to make a new generation of androids capable of eliminating human limitations and suppressing the world's inequality. Being about to live with 3 robots for a period of time, this is the opportunity to understand how robots' minds are projected and how they interpret all different types of experiences. But a question circles his mind: is it possible to teach a machine the meaning of human love?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
埃文是一名人工智能专业的研究生，梦想制造出新一代仿生人，突破人类自身的局限，消除世界上的不平等。他即将与三个机器人共同生活一段时间，这也是了解机器人思维如何被构建、如何理解各种经历的机会。然而，一个问题始终萦绕在他心头：机器能够学会人类之爱的意义吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952750/]Steam[/url]]
